verdict.rationale: A GPU's bundled companion software, AMD Software, offers game stats and performance reports, so AI-generated insights inside that software is a plausible capability for this product type. However, no evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions feature. The ROCm support for vLLM, llama.cpp and PyTorch only provides building blocks for users to run their own AI workloads, which earns no credit for this story.
